family_title_en: Complete the sentence with a two-syllable word: harder

stages.ix_title: Complete the sentence with a two-syllable word: harder

what_to_do.en: Tap the two-syllable word that fits.

stages.choice_rule: Four lowercase roots-list words. One correct two-syllable word finishes the stem. Tier 1 distractors are one-syllable and far in meaning. Tier 2 mixes one unfit two-syllable word with one-syllable topic words. Tier 3 uses two-syllable near misses. Vary answer_index. No phrases, names, or pictures in the choices.

gold_items.stem: She put the baby under a
She drew a yellow flower on the
The little puppy hid from the loud
Grandma made a sweet cake with
The class sang a happy song at the
After lunch <NAME> found a letter in a

roots: Use exactly four choices, and exactly one of them may finish the sentence.
The correct choice is always one two-syllable whole word from the roots list.
Wrong choices are whole words from the roots list. Never use sounds, blends, or letter names as choices.
A distractor must not also make a normal Grade 2 sentence.
Tier 1 distractors are three one-syllable words with a far meaning. Set explain_key to two_beats.
Tier 2 uses one two-syllable word that does not fit and one-syllable words from the same kid topic. Set explain_key to best_fit.
Tier 3 distractors are two-syllable near misses in meaning or grammar. Set explain_key to best_fit.
Do not use brands, real names, or misspelled words. Use <NAME> only in the stem.

tier_rules.1: Use four to six words. The answer is an easy-to-hear two-syllable word. All three distractors are one-syllable and cannot finish the sentence.
tier_rules.2: Use five to eight words. The answer is a grade-level two-syllable word. Add one two-syllable word that does not fit, plus one-syllable words from the same kid topic.
tier_rules.3: Use up to ten words, sometimes with <NAME>. Distractors are two-syllable near misses in meaning or grammar, and only one choice finishes the sentence.

two_beats.en: The right word has two beats. Say the whole word and clap twice.
two_beats.ko: 맞는 단어는 두 박자입니다. 단어 전체를 말하며 손뼉을 두 번 치세요.

best_fit.en: Some wrong words also have two beats. Pick the one that makes the sentence true.
best_fit.ko: 틀린 단어도 두 박자일 수 있습니다. 문장을 맞게 하는 단어를 고르세요.
